author: Stimulating
body:
I've been noticing an issue with communication amongst players that speak languages other than English, mostly Spanish. I feel like there is a lack of staff (not to complain) that can fluently speak other languages, and as I said, mostly Spanish, which creates a Language Barrier between the staff and players. I'm not saying be completely biased towards fluent spanish speakers, but I feel that the server would be a better place with a few more staff fluent in other languages to help players along, as I feel we're losing players in this way. Just a suggestion. 

Sorry I didn't get this out sooner.

Thanks, 

-Shadow

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
We have a lot of French speaking staff at least!

You do make an interesting point. We aren't staff to just ban ban ban, we have to always try to connect with the community as well. If a fraction of the community can't be spoken to by the majority of our staff due to not being understood (language barrier, I mean), then we can't connect with them nearly as well, which is an issue. However, we're not going to make someone a mod because of the language(s) they speak, it's simply a bonus feature.

If someone was online with me while dealing with an issue, and assisted me with translating, it would show that they have genuine interest in helping the server, which would give them an excellent chance at being promoted to a Jr Mod, in my opinion. Catch my drift here?

tl;dr We're not going to look at someones languages and automatically put them above others in terms of promoting, it's simply a small bonus.
